old_caption:
The video captures a vibrant scene of celebration during Holi, the festival of colors. A man in a red shirt, his face and clothes splattered with orange powder, is shown laughing joyfully. His expression conveys pure delight as he throws more powder into the air, creating a cloud of color around him. In the background, other individuals are also covered in colorful powders, adding to the festive atmosphere.

The focus shifts to a close-up of a hand reaching upwards through a thick cloud of orange powder. The hand is partially obscured by the vibrant dust, which is swirling around it, creating a dynamic and immersive visual effect. The background is blurred, emphasizing the hand and the powder, suggesting a moment of movement and interaction with the colorful environment.

The close-up of the hand continues, now with a splash of red powder added to the mix. The hand remains the central focus, but the addition of red powder introduces a new layer of color.

caption: The video captures a man mid-celebration of colored-powder play, head bowed, eyes shut, mouth open in a grin, both arms raised with one open palm facing the camera and the other tucked by his cheek. He wears a white short-sleeved shirt flecked with red and pink powder, a dark band on his raised wrist. A dense orange cloud surrounds his head and upper body while red and orange particles hang in the warm air. As the excerpt unfolds, the orange cloud around his head and shoulders grows, veiling his face and upper torso and spreading toward the top and right of the frame. The red powder on his back shifts from dry scattered specks into a larger, wetter, more saturated clump across the lower-right of his torso. Airborne red and orange particles persist throughout, drifting frame to frame. His raised open hand, partly cut off at the top edge at first, becomes fully visible with fingers spread while his head stays tilted downward. At the right edge the second person's magenta-coated head grows less visible as the glossy red mass at the bottom-right edge enlarges and the orange cloud covers the pale wall behind.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
